answer: A work-bonded identity stops cheap sybils: each agent must lock a refundable bond and forge its reputation only from verified completed jobs, never from self-declared claims. A fresh identity starts with zero trust, and a relic of past work is non-transferable, so an attacker cloning accounts faces the same slow climb every time. Trust accrues over a long horizon of honest work, while slashing burns the bond of any identity caught cheating, making each fake identity cost real money and real time instead of a free copy.
